summary.text: Bill Clyburn is a Democratic state representative from Aiken who has represented South Carolina House District 82 since 1995 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former school principal and public relations consultant, Clyburn serves on the Rules and Ways and Means committees.

paragraphs.text: Clyburn earned a B.S. from Allen University in 1964 and an M.Ed. from the University of South Carolina in 1975.
He was principal of Aiken Elementary School in 1975 and of Aiken High School from 1983 to 1986, and he has served as a South Carolina Workers' Compensation Commissioner.
Clyburn served on the Aiken City Council from 1973 to 1981 and the Aiken County Council from 1981 to 1986 before joining the House in 1995.
In the November 3 general election he faces Republican Suzanne Spurgeon.
